question.text: Managers of AIFs/VCFs classified as 'Self-certification REs' under CSCRF are exempt from the mandatory Market-SOC (M-SOC) requirement if their client base is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular (April 30, 2025, footnote reference): Managers of AIFs/VCFs classified as Self-certification REs and with a CLIENT BASE OF LESS THAN 100 shall be exempted from the mandatory Market-SOC (M-SOC) requirement. The Trap: The other options misstate the threshold. Cross-Exam Context: Same carve-out in XIX-C/D. Manager's Pro-Tip: Right-size your investor count relative to M-SOC economics — a 100th onboarded investor may tip you into M-SOC compliance costing INR 50+ lakh/year in security operations. If you're near 100 clients, re-test the cost-benefit of adding new onboardings vs consolidating via feeder/co-invest vehicles.
